boundary: No transaction: ValidateSaltFilter.doFilter, on a POST that is not an already-handled multipart Struts action, calls SaltValidator.requireSubmittedSalt -> consumeSubmittedSalt (SaltValidator.java:52), which calls RollerSession.getRollerSession; that runs two auto-committing JPA reads of its own (JPAUserManagerImpl.getUserByUserName -> getUser, RollerSession.java:81/91, on roller_user) and, only when a principal exists with no cached user and LDAP auto-provisioning is enabled, conditionally calls the explicit region BasicUserAutoProvision.execute (RollerSession.java:90, commits on its own, writes roller_user and userrole); the salt cache get/remove under `synchronized (saltCache)` (SaltValidator.java:100-105) is an in-memory lock, not a database one.
notes: Same pattern as LoadSaltFilter (b8867bf78f76): the called explicit transaction's writes are correctly folded into this record's header; shape read-then-write matches the overlap on roller_user.
